e_ref_caveat: E_REF is NOT a free normalisation knob. `norm_sq_error` is used by the REWARD as well as by feature [0], so moving it changes what the agent is optimising, not merely how the observation is scaled. Its row is informational only.
note: Only three of the eight normalising constants clip anything at their current value. The other five were swept for the same reason the three were: 'assumed not to clip' is the judgement that has failed most often here. The negative result is the point of running them.
